source_clause: C1.) Whenever changes to the climate system are made via hard controls or touchscreen, these changes are reflected in both locations. Whenever fan speed or temperature hard controls are used (even if at highest/lowest setting), according pop-ups are shown if NOT on climate screen (timeout after 3 sec), and changes are reflected in status bar/ status indicator on category button. When sync'd, do not show slider pop-up on passenger side when adjusting driver slider. If the user is outside of the climate main category and the temperature is changed through hard controls, a pop-up will be shown coming down from that temperature in the status bar to indicate it is being altered, for ATC it will display the degree (or half degree increments for Celsius and for Fahrenheit do not show half degrees) being set, for MTC (if the MTC has a Climate screen) it will display a slider bar with the arrow pointing to the current setting, this information will change as the user alters the temp. If on climate screen, status changes are indicated directly on touchscreen buttons / status indicator on category button and will not be shown in the status bar. If changes are made on climate screen, LEDs on hard controls reflect new status.
reasoning: 驗證目標：2.2（C1）定義硬鍵與觸控之狀態互相反映，以及使用者在／不在 climate screen 時之呈現差異，八個 037 leaf 分別對應鏡射、popup、狀態列、Sync 抑制、ATC 呈現、MTC 呈現、在 climate screen 之呈現、LED 回饋，一葉一 TC（§8.2.1）。關鍵情境條件：硬鍵與觸控之存在依 R-C31 為句子之執行前提，標 spec-derived 並具名「Whenever changes to the climate system are made via hard controls or touchscreen」；另依 33 §4.1 之實質複查補第十三軸之排除項，標 (2.14) 並具名「no HVAC menu bar icons, no HVAC screens and no HVAC pop ups will be displayed」——3 旋鈕 ICS 之車輛無氣候觸控畫面，本節八條於該車皆不可執行，故 2.14 依 R-C29 併入 specification_reference，僅取其裝備事實而不驗其行為（§8.2.1）；-05／-06 另取 profile §3.2 第一軸 ATC／MTC，其第一問由「for ATC it will display the degree」「for MTC (if the MTC has a Climate screen)」兩句明文對應；-04 之 passenger side 蘊含雙區以上，取第二軸。為什麼這樣切：八者之失效互相獨立（狀態列正確而 popup 逾時錯、ATC 呈現正確而 MTC 呈現錯），且分屬不同觀察位置，合併後無法定位。刻意略過：「timeout after 3 sec」之秒數為條文明載故照用（R-C22 不適用），而 popup 之樣式、尺寸與動畫本節未定義，不寫入；-06 之「if the MTC has a Climate screen」為條文自身之限定語，照錄為 pre_condition，其非獨立配置變數而為第十三軸之後果，依 33 §3 不另立軸。

tcs.tc_title: Hard control and touchscreen changes mirror each other
tcs.test_item: Whenever changes to the climate system are made via hard controls or touchscreen, these changes shall be reflected in both locations
tcs.pre_conditions:
1. [spec-derived] The vehicle has climate hard controls and a climate touchscreen (2.2)
2. [spec-derived] The vehicle does not have 3 knob HVAC controls with ICS, for which no HVAC screens or pop ups are displayed (2.14)
3. [spec-derived] The vehicle is not an EMEA ICS vehicle, whose climate interface is specified separately in chapter 16 (16.2)
tcs.test_procedure:
1. Open the climate screen
2. Change the fan speed using the fan speed hard control
3. Change the temperature on the climate screen
tcs.expected_result:
1. The climate screen shows the current fan speed and temperature
2. The fan speed shown on the climate screen is the one set by the hard control
3. The temperature indicated by the hard controls is the one set on the climate screen
tcs.design_method: 功能測試 (Functional based ; no specific technique)

tcs.tc_title: Pop-up appears off the climate screen and times out
tcs.test_item: Whenever fan speed or temperature hard controls are used (even if at highest/lowest setting), according pop-ups shall be shown if NOT on climate screen, and shall time out after 3 sec
tcs.pre_conditions:
1. [spec-derived] The vehicle has climate hard controls and a climate touchscreen (2.2)
2. [spec-derived] The vehicle does not have 3 knob HVAC controls with ICS, for which no HVAC screens or pop ups are displayed (2.14)
3. [spec-derived] The vehicle is not an EMEA ICS vehicle, whose climate interface is specified separately in chapter 16 (16.2)
tcs.test_procedure:
1. Open a screen other than the climate screen
2. Change the fan speed using the fan speed hard control
3. Do not interact with the head unit for 3 seconds
tcs.expected_result:
1. The climate screen is not displayed
2. A fan speed pop-up is shown
3. The fan speed pop-up is no longer shown

tcs.tc_title: Status bar and category button indicator follow the change
tcs.test_item: Whenever fan speed or temperature hard controls are used, the changes shall be reflected in the status bar and in the status indicator on the category button
tcs.pre_conditions:
1. [spec-derived] The vehicle has climate hard controls and a climate touchscreen (2.2)
2. [spec-derived] The vehicle does not have 3 knob HVAC controls with ICS, for which no HVAC screens or pop ups are displayed (2.14)
3. [spec-derived] The vehicle is not an EMEA ICS vehicle, whose climate interface is specified separately in chapter 16 (16.2)
4. [spec-derived] The vehicle is not configured with a non-foldable secondary lower screen containing comfort information, for which the comfort section is removed from the head unit (6.3)
tcs.test_procedure:
1. Open a screen other than the climate screen
2. Change the fan speed using the fan speed hard control
3. Read the status indicator on the comfort category button
tcs.expected_result:
1. The climate screen is not displayed
2. The status bar shows the new fan speed
3. The status indicator on the comfort category button shows the new fan speed
tcs.design_method: 功能測試 (Functional based ; no specific technique)

tcs.tc_title: Sync suppresses the passenger side slider pop-up
tcs.test_item: When sync'd, the system shall not show the slider pop-up on the passenger side when the driver slider is adjusted
tcs.pre_conditions:
1. [spec-derived] The vehicle has climate hard controls and a climate touchscreen (2.2)
2. [spec-derived] The vehicle has a passenger side temperature control (2.2)
3. [spec-derived] The vehicle does not have 3 knob HVAC controls with ICS, for which no HVAC screens or pop ups are displayed (2.14)
4. [spec-derived] The vehicle is not an EMEA ICS vehicle, whose climate interface is specified separately in chapter 16 (16.2)
tcs.test_procedure:
1. Turn Sync on
2. Adjust the driver temperature slider
tcs.expected_result:
1. Sync is on
2. No slider pop-up is shown on the passenger side
tcs.design_method: 功能測試 (Functional based ; no specific technique)

tcs.tc_title: ATC pop-up shows the degree with unit-dependent half degrees
tcs.test_item: If the user is outside of the climate main category and the temperature is changed through hard controls, for ATC the pop-up shall display the degree being set, in half degree increments for Celsius, and for Fahrenheit it shall not show half degrees
tcs.pre_conditions:
1. [spec-derived] The vehicle has climate hard controls and a climate touchscreen (2.2)
2. [spec-verbatim] The climate system is ATC (2.2)
3. [spec-derived] The vehicle does not have 3 knob HVAC controls with ICS, for which no HVAC screens or pop ups are displayed (2.14)
4. [spec-derived] The vehicle is not an EMEA ICS vehicle, whose climate interface is specified separately in chapter 16 (16.2)
tcs.test_procedure:
1. Open a screen outside the climate main category
2. Set the temperature unit to Celsius
3. Change the temperature using the temperature hard control
4. Set the temperature unit to Fahrenheit
5. Change the temperature using the temperature hard control
tcs.expected_result:
1. The climate main category is not displayed
2. The temperature unit is Celsius
3. A pop-up comes down from the temperature in the status bar and displays the degree being set, in half degree increments
4. The temperature unit is Fahrenheit
5. A pop-up comes down from the temperature in the status bar and displays the degree being set, without half degrees

tcs.tc_title: MTC pop-up shows a slider bar with the arrow at the setting
tcs.test_item: If the user is outside of the climate main category and the temperature is changed through hard controls, for MTC the pop-up shall display a slider bar with the arrow pointing to the current setting, and this information shall change as the user alters the temp
tcs.pre_conditions:
1. [spec-derived] The vehicle has climate hard controls and a climate touchscreen (2.2)
2. [spec-verbatim] The climate system is MTC (2.2)
3. [spec-verbatim] The MTC has a Climate screen (2.2)
4. [spec-derived] The vehicle does not have 3 knob HVAC controls with ICS, for which no HVAC screens or pop ups are displayed (2.14)
5. [spec-derived] The vehicle is not an EMEA ICS vehicle, whose climate interface is specified separately in chapter 16 (16.2)
tcs.test_procedure:
1. Open a screen outside the climate main category
2. Change the temperature using the temperature hard control
3. Continue altering the temperature using the temperature hard control
tcs.expected_result:
1. The climate main category is not displayed
2. A pop-up comes down from the temperature in the status bar and displays a slider bar with the arrow pointing to the current setting
3. The arrow moves with the temperature being set
tcs.design_method: 功能測試 (Functional based ; no specific technique)

tcs.tc_title: On the climate screen no status bar pop-up is shown
tcs.test_item: If on climate screen, status changes shall be indicated directly on the touchscreen buttons and the status indicator on the category button, and shall not be shown in the status bar
tcs.pre_conditions:
1. [spec-derived] The vehicle has climate hard controls and a climate touchscreen (2.2)
2. [spec-derived] The vehicle does not have 3 knob HVAC controls with ICS, for which no HVAC screens or pop ups are displayed (2.14)
3. [spec-derived] The vehicle is not an EMEA ICS vehicle, whose climate interface is specified separately in chapter 16 (16.2)
4. [spec-derived] The vehicle is not configured with a non-foldable secondary lower screen containing comfort information, for which the comfort section is removed from the head unit (6.3)
tcs.test_procedure:
1. Open the climate screen
2. Change the fan speed using the fan speed hard control
3. Read the status bar
tcs.expected_result:
1. The climate screen is displayed
2. The new fan speed is indicated on the climate screen's touchscreen buttons and on the status indicator on the category button
3. No pop-up is shown in the status bar
tcs.design_method: 功能測試 (Functional based ; no specific technique)

tcs.tc_title: Hard control LEDs follow a change made on the climate screen
tcs.test_item: If changes are made on climate screen, LEDs on hard controls shall reflect the new status
tcs.pre_conditions:
1. [spec-derived] The vehicle has climate hard controls and a climate touchscreen (2.2)
2. [spec-derived] The vehicle does not have 3 knob HVAC controls with ICS, for which no HVAC screens or pop ups are displayed (2.14)
3. [spec-derived] The vehicle is not an EMEA ICS vehicle, whose climate interface is specified separately in chapter 16 (16.2)
tcs.test_procedure:
1. Open the climate screen
2. Change the fan speed on the climate screen
3. Read the LEDs on the fan speed hard control
tcs.expected_result:
1. The climate screen is displayed
2. The climate screen shows the new fan speed
3. The LEDs on the fan speed hard control show the new fan speed
tcs.design_method: 功能測試 (Functional based ; no specific technique)
